title: Occurrence of Novel Human Tomato Brown Rugose Fruit Virus and Conventional Microbial Source Tracking Genetic Markers in a Hawaiian Coupled Stream-Beach System

Fecal contamination of coastal waters threatens human and ecosystem health. Microbial source tracking (MST) methods offer a strategy to identify sources of fecal contamination through the measurement of genetic markers...
